These sources are extracted during the download phase but are not executed, as `--noprepare` and `--nobuild` prevent any build or prepare functions from running.

Sourcing this PKGBUILD during `makepkg --printsrcinfo` or `--nobuild` poses no risk of arbitrary code execution.
